title: Transfer | Clinic Follow-up Constraint Intake
goal: Read patient callback messages and extract follow-up appointment constraints into `/root/clinic_followup_constraints.json`, capturing visit duration, allowed days, preferred visit windows, temporary no-visit dates, and timing conditions such as fasting or post-treatment waiting windows.
skillBenefitRationale: This transfers the same extraction skill into a healthcare intake setting where temporal rules are phrased differently and often mix hard constraints with soft preferences.
